selection_reason: 32-sample ranges improve development results over uniform proposals and have similar measured strength to 128 samples at lower inference cost; select the fast candidate before holdout.
changes_allowed: Correctness fixes only; do not tune strategy using held-out results.

history_plan: Separate 50-hand-session clusters, history on/off paired with the same seed and field; not a human-realism validation.
